openings.claim: Layout transitions may add selection/checking time beyond layout difficulty.
openings.discriminator: Within layout and worker, blocked sequences shorten selection/checking, especially after switches; insertion changes less.
openings.fit: Retains full assembly, geometry and removable parts; resequencing must preserve order identity, count, color and deadline.
openings.probe: Reuse five samples with both workers; reverse blocked/interleaved order, match layouts/colors, time four phases and independently tally contents.
openings.uncertainty: Intrinsic difficulty, practice and sample wear may explain differences; budget and scheduling feasibility remain unverified.

openings.claim: Order-specific component-to-slot maps may clarify short-partition placement; matching role checklists may detect packing omissions/substitutions.
openings.discriminator: Separate customer placement with verified contents from workshop detection of known missing/wrong parts.
openings.fit: Retains geometry, removable connections, selected counts and colors; added preparation/checking must fit cost, time and deadline limits.
openings.probe: Use ten samples and ten randomized participants, five per diagram condition, balancing layouts. Record unaided completion within ten minutes and placement questions/errors. Separately seed omissions/substitutions; measure checking and diagram preparation time and cost.
openings.uncertainty: Small exploratory sample; actual missing-part causes and response to guidance remain unknown.

decision: Probe both; neither explains insertion retries or establishes pilot success. Preserve 30x20 footprint and assortment; confirm initial cost <=500, recurring addition <=0.40 and fixed delivery. Validate 60-unit completeness >=98%, median workshop time <=8 minutes and unaided arrangement >=90% before claiming success.
